translations.tagline: Dio avrebbe avuto pietà. John Rambo no!

translations.overview: Combat has taken its toll on Rambo, but he's finally begun to find inner peace in a monastery. When Rambo's friend and mentor Col. Trautman asks for his help on a top secret mission to Afghanistan, Rambo declines but must reconsider when Trautman is captured.
translations.tagline: The first was for himself. The second was for his country. This time is for his friend.
